interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Yɔrɔ ka Previ tab fara HTML ani SVG kodo blocks kan. HTML bɛ ka model-generated page laben sandboxed frame la min bɛ a yɛrɛ ka scripts laben nga a tɛ se ka Novera, a ka filew, walima rezo; SVG bɛ a laben statiki la ni scripts ti se ka baara kɛ.
interface.autoGenerateTitleDesc: Ka kumaɲɔgɔnya kuraw fara ɲɔgɔn kan a yɛrɛ fɛ ka kɛ filana tɔgɔ ye. Ka a bila ka taga ni tɔgɔ ye ka ta fɔ ka se ka a tɔgɔ yelema.
interface.windowBackgroundDesc: Jatɛminɛ ni porogaramu fenetiri ka dakun kulu ye.
interface.primaryDesc: Ka ɲɛnamaya ɲɛnamaya kɛ ka ɲɛnamaya kɛ.
interface.accentDesc: Ɲɛnawoloma ɲɛnamaya kulu min bɛ waleya UI kan.
interface.destructiveDesc: A’ ye kulɛri min be mɔgɔw ɲɛɛ na, o sigi kɛwale tiɲɛni kama.
interface.resetToDefault: Ka ta a la ka kɛ a yɛrɛ ye
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Yɛlɛmako laban ka interface labɛncogo bɛɛ la ka taa a yɛrɛ ma.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: Interface settings were restored to default.
interface.threadScrollTitle: Dakun min bɛ ka kɛ ni filani ye
interface.threadScrollDesc: Sugandili kɛ cogo min na kunnafolifalen ka ɲɛnamaya ka kan ka waleya tuma min na kumalaseta kuraw bɛ na.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Ka Viewport datugu ka taga ka ɲɛsin kunafoni laban ma min segina.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: A bɛ se ka kɛ awtomatiki la tuma min na jaabiw bɛ bɔ waati yɛrɛ la.
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Ka se ka jatɛminɛ kɛ kumaɲɔgɔnya kɔnɔ. Ni a balilendo, ka se ka jatɛminɛ kɛ inafo a bɛ sɔrɔ inafo inafo.
interface.codeBlockDesc: Ɲɛnawoloma kɛ ni sintaksi ɲɛfɔcogo ye.
interface.showLineNumbersDesc: Ka ɲɛnamaya kɛ ni liɲi nimɛriw ye sariyabolo kɔnɔ.
interface.resetCodeBlockStyleDesc: Yɛlɛma ta ka kɔdi bloki cogo la ka taa a yɛrɛ ma.

interface.resetCodeBlockSuccessDesc: Ɲinini bɛ kɛ ka ɲɛsin a ma ka ɲɛsin a yɛrɛ ma.

hardware.name: Jamana
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Ka baara kɛ ni Vulkan API ye ka GPU akasiyali kɛ. Ka Vulkan bila baara la ni NVIDIA GPU de bɛ i na fɔ a bɛ se ka kɛ sababu ye ka ꞃɔgonnaw kɛ.
hardware.deviceListError: A tɛ se ka GPU minɛnw kalan
hardware.noDevicesDesc: GPU fɔiy tɛ se ka don llama.cpp masini ma. Modelw bɛ baara kɛ CPU kan.
hardware.backendApiDesc: K'a llama.cpp k'a labaara a GPU n'a
hardware.backendSelectDesc: Labaara nin API kama nin GPU kama
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: GPU n'a k'a bɛ se memori pool defa fɔ CPU — model k'a labaara fɔ memori defa fɔ sistem n'a.
hardware.engineRestartedForDevices: Wou ka GPUs y'a yèlèman, sabouna local engine y'a daminè kokura. Models reloaded on next use.
hardware.engineBusyDevicesChanged: Wou ka GPUs y'a yèlèman, n'ga modèlè dô y'a baaralen ye. A bè bô, o kônô a b'a da ka Refresh k'a ta GPU koura la.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: Proxy server ka URL ani port.

httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: Hosts ka lisi faralen ɲɔgɔn kan ni kɔma ye walasa ka proxy bila.

webSearch.title: Ɲinini ni Web ye
webSearch.description: A ka kan k'u ɲini ani k'u kalan webɛ la ka baara kɛ ni Novera ka baarakɛ minɛnw ye.
webSearch.enable: K'a Se ka Ɲinini Kɛ Webu kan
webSearch.enableDesc: Ka web_search ani web_fetch baarakɛcogow jira suguyaw ma munnu bɛ baarakɛcogow dɛmɛ. A bɛ baara kɛ ka bɔ bokisi la ni API baarakɛcogo tɛ.
webSearch.providerDesc: Kɔfɛla min be web_search ani web_fetch jaabi, o sugandi.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: A bɛ se ka kɛ. Ka {{provider}} API kumaden di ka se ka hakɛya ba sɔrɔ ani ka jabi labɛnnen. Ka a to fɔlo la ka baara kɛ ni kumaden tɛ min na laban ye.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: Ka kan ka kɛ. {{provider}} ka kan ka API fɔcɔgɔ kɛ ka jabi ta.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Ka kan. Baasi URL ka don {{provider}} ka misali la, ni JSON API ka baarali ye.

cowork.title: Cowork
cowork.description: Cowork ka baarakɛla yɔrɔ labɛn: a ka bɔgɔdaga nɛgɛdaga, ka fara hakilijigikow ni sekow kan minw maranin be tuma bɛɛ i ka Novera kunnafoniw marayɔrɔ la.
cowork.shellSandboxed: Kumadenw bɛ baara kɛ ni {{backend}} ye: u bɛ se ka sɛbɛn dron sɛsiɔn baara yɔrɔ kɔnɔ, ani fayilow munnu bɛ a ka ɲɛnamaya lisi kɔnɔ tɛ se ka kalan.
cowork.shellUnavailable: Sandbox tɛ sɔrɔ nin sisitɛmu kan, o la shell baarakɛcogo tɛ di. Kumadenw tɛ waleya ka sɔrɔ u tɛ datugu.
cowork.network: Yɔrɔ min na ka Réseau Accessi
cowork.networkDesc: A bɛ Cowork kumadenw to ka taa rezo la, ka baaraw kɛ i n'a fɔ pakanɛ sigili walima marayɔrɔ sɔrɔli. A bɛ baara la ni default ye. Kumaɲɔgɔnya ɲɛnamaya shell ma se ka rezo taa.
cowork.noMemories: Miiriya tɛ yen hali bi. Models bɛ u fara a kan ni memory_write baarakɛcogo ye i n'a fɔ u bɛ fɛn kalan min ka kan ka mara.
cowork.noSkills: Kalanw tɛ yen hali bi. Kalan ye ɲɛfɔliw faralen ɲɔgɔn kan ye min bɛ se ka waleya kokura model min bɛ se ka labaara ni demɛ ye.
cowork.editMemoryDesc: Dakun kelen ka se sɛbɛni kelen ma. Models bɛ u kalan ni memory_read baarakɛcogo ye.
cowork.editSkillDesc: Markdown ɲɛfɔliw, ka se ka ɲɛfɔli kɛ YAML dakun kɔnɔ. ɲɛfɔli ye min bɛ modelw ye sani ka dɔnniya labaara.
cowork.loadFailed: A tɛ se ka baarakɛla ka baarayɔrɔ da
cowork.deleteFailed: A ma se ka dizili kɛ
cowork.revealFailed: A ma se ka sɛbɛn ɲɛ "%s" datugu
